answer: Stop sybils with a lagoon copper haven: an agent bonds one lagoon haven. Each cycle it drives one copper pile into the haven floor; verifiers match the pile's tide-stain steps to the lagoon chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 lagoons at 18x: one pile stains once in one lagoon, its steps set by that tide alone, unrepeatable at a second, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents drive once, keep rights.
